postconditions.expression: Result<T> MUST force explicit handling of error states.

typeRef.literalValue: "UTF-8 Text Sequence. MUST be valid UTF-8."
"IEEE 754 Double Precision. MUST NOT be used for Money."
"Fixed-point arithmetic. MUST be used for exact precision."
"True/False logic. MUST NOT use truthy/falsy coercion."
"ISO 8601 Timestamp. MUST be stored as UTC."
"Success or Failure Monad. Forces explicit error handling."
"Dynamic / Unsafe. Type safety is explicitly opted-out."
"Exact value match. MUST fail validation if the value does not match exactly."

Self-Definition Level.name: Self-Definition Level
Self-Definition Level.rationale: The .gasd file MUST be a 100% faithful representation of the MD specification.

globalConstraints.text: A GASD Transpiler MUST NOT invent new annotations for functional logic.
All database operations SHALL be documented via PERSIST or ACHIEVE.
Every COMPONENT MUST expose an INTERFACE.
VALIDATE steps MUST include AS TYPE.X binding. Transpiler MUST error if binding is missing or resolves to undefined TYPE.
In VERSION 1.2, ACHIEVE steps MUST include a POSTCONDITION block.
In VERSION 1.2, IMPORT statements MUST have a corresponding CONTRACT definition.
In VERSION 1.2, INVARIANT statements MUST specify LOCAL or GLOBAL scope.
In VERSION 1.2, all annotations MUST include an AS identifier.
AS obligation identifiers MUST be unique within file scope.
AS obligation identifiers MUST match the pattern [A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*.
In VERSION 1.2, missing AS identifier SHALL produce an error.
In VERSION 1.1, missing AS identifiers are auto-generated deterministically from TYPE.field.annotation.
A FLOW MUST NOT contain implementation code.

assumptions.name: DI container configured correctly
assumptions.consequence: Components will not be resolved if DI container is misconfigured.

assumptions.name: Thread pool size >= required concurrency
assumptions.consequence: Async operations may block if thread pool is exhausted.

assumptions.name: Encryption key management configured
assumptions.consequence: Sensitive data may be exposed if encryption is not configured.

assumptions.name: Auth service available
assumptions.consequence: Authorization checks will fail if auth service is unavailable.

assumptions.name: External service latency within bounds
assumptions.consequence: TimeoutException behavior undefined if external service exceeds expected latency.

assumptions.name: Cache infrastructure available
assumptions.consequence: Caching will be bypassed if cache infrastructure is unavailable.

assumptions.name: DB-level unique constraint exists
assumptions.consequence: Uniqueness enforcement may be inconsistent without DB-level constraint.
